name: Visual areas structural connections by eccentricity and polar angle
summary: Builds polar-angle by eccentricity visual-field parcellations from pRF maps, segments the tractogram into connections between them with MRtrix3, and outputs connectomes, networks, network statistics and tracts.
description: Generates wedge-by-eccentricity ROIs from the pRF polar angle and eccentricity surface maps on the FreeSurfer surface, projects them into DWI space and combines them with the visual-area parcellation; then assigns streamlines with tck2connectome, extracts the tracts connecting each pair of regions with connectome2tck, builds count, density and length connectomes, networks and network measures (cxnetwork), a cortexmap and a white matter classification. Use it to study structural connectivity of visual cortex along polar-angle meridians and eccentricity. Needs DWI, FreeSurfer output, pRF results, a tractogram and a visual-area parcellation of the same subject.

inputs.description: DWI of the subject; used as the reference space for the generated parcellations.
FreeSurfer subject directory; surfaces used to map pRF data into the volume.
pRF mapping results (polar angle and eccentricity surface maps and vertices).
Visual-area volumetric parcellation with its label file.

outputs.description: Count, density and length connectivity matrices between the polar angle x eccentricity regions.
Networks built from the connectomes, with network measurements.
Polar angle x eccentricity volumetric parcellation in DWI space.
Cortexmap with the polar angle x eccentricity surface maps.
Tractogram of the streamlines connecting the regions.
White matter classification of the region-to-region tracts, with region surfaces for viewing.

parameters.description: Space-separated polar-angle meridians at which wedges are centred.
Half-width of each polar-angle wedge around its meridian.
Width of each eccentricity bin from 0 to 8 degrees.
FreeSurfer parcellation (aparc or aparc.a2009s) combined with the visual-field regions.
Radial search distance passed to MRtrix3 tck2connectome -assignment_radial_search when assigning streamline endpoints to nodes (used only if different from 4).
Value for tck2connectome -assignment_reverse_search; leave blank to not use it.
Value for tck2connectome -assignment_forward_search; leave blank to not use it.
Percentile threshold used to compute the rich-club coefficient in the network measurements.
Analysis pipeline to run; only polarAngleMeridiansConnectomics is implemented.
If true, also add a peripheral eccentricity bin from 8 to 90 degrees.

How streamlines are assigned to visual regions: both_endpoints builds connectomes, networks and network statistics between regions; single_endpoints (v1.1 only) segments streamlines terminating in each visual area.
